data.description: Iconic Creek Views | Luxury Home | Move-In Ready
data.display_address: 17 Icon Bay, Dubai Creek Harbour (The Lagoons), Dubai
data.long_description:
Provident Real Estate proudly presents this exceptional 2-bedroom apartment in 17 Icon Bay by Emaar, an iconic waterfront residence located within the prestigious Dubai Creek Harbour. Offered for AED 179,000 per annum, this fully furnished and upgraded home combines sophisticated interiors, breathtaking panoramic views, and a prime location in one of Dubai's most sought-after master communities.


  Positioned on a high floor, the apartment enjoys uninterrupted views of the picturesque Dubai Creek and the iconic Burj Khalifa skyline. Designed to maximize natural light and open space, the residence features floor-to-ceiling windows, an elegant open-plan living and dining area, a contemporary kitchen fitted with premium appliances, and a private balcony perfect for enjoying Dubai's spectacular skyline.


  Developed by Emaar Properties, 17 Icon Bay offers residents a vibrant waterfront lifestyle with direct access to Creek Marina, landscaped promenades, retail outlets, cafés, and world-class leisure facilities, all within minutes of Downtown Dubai and Dubai International Airport.

  Developed by one of Dubai's most trusted developers, Emaar Properties, 17 Icon Bay represents the perfect balance of luxury, convenience, and waterfront living. Whether you're seeking a premium residence or an exceptional lifestyle close to the city's most iconic landmarks, this beautifully furnished apartment is an outstanding choice.
